name: gitea-connector
description: Manage Gitea projects with direct repository tools and a safety-filtered operations catalog.

interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to git.bratonien.de with direct tools for files, multi-file commits, branches, tags, issues, pull requests, reviews, merges, and releases plus a safety-filtered operations catalog. Passwords, tokens, secrets, keys, user administration, permissions, runners, and webhooks are excluded. Writes and destructive actions require confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Show the latest commits in a repository.
Summarize open issues and pull requests.
